title: Otis Elevator Company Pty Ltd - proposed acquisition of Independent Lifting Services Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the proposed acquisition in the context of the following markets: -  the provision of lift installation and modernisation services; and -  the provision of lift maintenance services. The ACCC did not consider it necessary to form a definitive view in regard to the geographical dimension of the market, particularly in relation to whether the market concerned was a national or state-based market, as the proposed acquisition was unlikely to raise concerns regardless of the market definition applied.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC formed the view that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in the relevant markets.  Factors informing this conclusion included: - there were a number of alternative suppliers which would continue to compete with Otis in the provision of lift installation and modernisation services and the provision of lift maintenance services; - the increase in Otis's market share as a result of the proposed acquisition would be minimal and ILS and Otis were not each other's closest competitors; and - the barriers to entry were relatively low  particularly for the supply of installation and maintenance services to small-medium sized buildings, where ILS activities were principally focussed.
